AgentRef.description: Who made a change; for software agents, which model (SUB-24).
AgentRef.title: AgentRef

AngleUnitEnum.description: Units an angle may be stored in (UCUM codes).
AngleUnitEnum.title: AngleUnitEnum

AngularRateUnitEnum.description: Units an angular rate may be stored in (UCUM codes). Degrees per minute is the analysts' standard for bearing rate.
AngularRateUnitEnum.title: AngularRateUnitEnum

AnnotationAppearance.description: How an annotation is drawn: its line, its fill and its label. Data colours do not change with the theme (DEV-07). Widths and sizes are in screen pixels, so they are the same at every zoom.

colour.description: Its line's colour, and a label's or a marker's dot. Lower-case hex RGB, for example "#c7820a". Label text is drawn in the theme's text colour, so it stays readable on any map.

fill_colour.description: Colour inside an area, circle or ellipse. Lower-case hex RGB. Left out, the line's colour.

fill_opacity.description: How opaque the fill of an area, circle or ellipse is, from 0 (none) to 1 (solid). Left out, 0.25 with a fill colour, or else a faint tint of 0.05, so what lies inside stays clear.

label_size.description: Height of its label's text in screen pixels.

line_width.description: Width of its line in screen pixels.

AnnotationAppearance.title: AnnotationAppearance

AnnotationFeature.description: Shapes, labels and chart furniture as ordinary GeoJSON (CAP-03). An annotation with only a time has null geometry and shall give a time or a time range (CAP-04); chart furniture has null geometry and needs neither. A circle or an ellipse is a polygon approximating it, for other tools, with its centre and size as properties, which Debrief draws from.
AnnotationFeature.title: AnnotationFeature

appearance.description: How it is drawn on the map. Left out, or any member of it left out, means Debrief's default for annotations. Content, like a track's colour: changing it is a recorded, undoable change (SUB-22).

items.description: The centre of a circle or an ellipse, [longitude, latitude] in WGS84 degrees. Its geometry is the polygon that approximates it.

furniture.description: What chart furniture it is. Chart furniture has no geometry and needs no time.

hidden.description: Not drawn on the map. Still listed, and still selectable, in the outline. Content: hiding is a recorded, undoable change (SUB-22).

orientation.description: The direction of an ellipse's longer axis from its centre, true north, clockwise.

radius.description: A circle's radius, along geodesics from its centre.

semi_major.description: Half an ellipse's longer axis, along the geodesic from its centre.

semi_minor.description: Half an ellipse's shorter axis, along the geodesic from its centre.

shape.description: How it is drawn. Required for circles and ellipses; otherwise it may be left out and follows from the geometry.

AnnotationShapeEnum.description: How an annotation is drawn (CAP-03). Left out, it follows from the geometry: a line string is a line, a polygon an area, a point a label (style label) or a marker, and no geometry a note. Circles and ellipses must say so, since GeoJSON has no curves: their geometry is a polygon that approximates them, for other tools, and their own properties (centre, radius or semi-axes and orientation) say exactly what they are.
AnnotationShapeEnum.title: AnnotationShapeEnum

AnnotationSpec.description: An annotation as the analyst describes it in a form, or an agent in a request: what is made into an annotation feature, recorded as one step in the plot's history (CAP-03, SUB-19). Positions are numbers here; forms read them in the analyst's notation and say what they mean.

items.description: [longitude, latitude] pairs: the line's positions, or the area's corners (not closed); one, the centre or position, for a circle, ellipse, label or marker; none for a note.

AnnotationSpec.title: AnnotationSpec

AssetKindEnum.description: What an asset holds in Debrief terms.
AssetKindEnum.title: AssetKindEnum

ChartFurnitureEnum.description: Chart furniture a plot can carry (CAP-03). The scale bar is always drawn.
ChartFurnitureEnum.title: ChartFurnitureEnum

ContextTracksEnum.description: How the map draws each track outside the time window: its context (CAP-29). An analyst's setting for the minimum contrast can show faint as visible, never hidden as anything else.
ContextTracksEnum.title: ContextTracksEnum

DebriefFeatureCollection.description: The unit of analysis (SUB-05), stored as an asset of a STAC item.

history.description: The plot's whole history: every step, with its provenance and whether it is applied, undone or abandoned, and the current step (SUB-19, SUB-21, decision 13 Oct). A GeoJSON foreign member, so other tools still read the file as GeoJSON. Not content: left out of every content hash. Last in the file. A plot sent to a view or a tool never carries it.

DebriefFeatureCollection.title: DebriefFeatureCollection

Delta.description: One recorded change, in the earlier layout: a file of its own in the plot's history folder. Read only to move a history into its plot file.

added.description: Features added, never with the whole-plot feature's view.

after.description: The delta this one was applied on top of (0 for the first).

modified.description: Features changed, in full, replacing those with the same id.

named_sets.description: Named sets added or replaced, by id.

order.description: Feature ids in the order the plot holds them after this change.

records.description: The operation that made the change.

result_hash.description: Content hash of the plot file after this delta, island left out.

seq.description: Position in the plot's history, from 1, with no gaps.

Delta.title: Delta

DurationUnitEnum.description: Units a duration may be stored in (UCUM codes).
DurationUnitEnum.title: DurationUnitEnum

FixMark.description: One fix of a track marked by the analyst, or by a legacy plot: drawn in a colour of its own, labelled on the map, or carrying a comment. Found by its time, not its place in the track, so a mark stays with its fix when fixes before it are removed, the track is split or merged, or it is moved, rotated, sheared, stretched or smoothed. Where two fixes share a time, the mark is the first's.

colour.description: The fix's own colour, lower-case hex RGB: its marker and the line from it to the next fix are drawn in it.

comment.description: Free text about the fix, shown when the analyst points at it and in the Timeline.

label.description: Text drawn on the map beside the fix.

time.description: The time of the fix marked; one of the track's times.

FixMark.title: FixMark

time_zone.description: IANA time zone for display, or UTC for Zulu time (SUB-01).

HistoryHead.description: Where a plot's history stood, in the earlier layout (history/head.json). Read only to move a history into its plot file.

abandoned.description: Deltas undone and then superseded by a new change.

current.description: Sequence number of the last delta the plot reflects; 0 for none.

plot_hash.description: Content hash the plot file has when it reflects current, island left out.

HistoryHead.title: HistoryHead

HistoryStep.description: One recorded change to a plot, in its plot file's history.

added.description: Features added. A whole-plot feature here never carries its view: the island is not content (SUB-22).

after.description: The step this one was applied on top of (0 for the first). Replay follows these links back from a step to the first.

modified.description: Features changed, in full, replacing those with the same id.

named_sets.description: Named sets added or replaced, by id.

order.description: Feature ids in the order the plot holds them after this change, when that is not the natural order (features kept in place, added ones last).

records.description: The operation that made the change. Usually one; a baseline step, taken when a plot made outside Debrief is first opened, carries all the plot's earlier records.

result_hash.description: Hash of the plot's content after this step: the plot file with its island and its history left out, as Debrief writes it (SUB-22).

seq.description: Position in the plot's history, from 1, with no gaps.

state.description: Applied, undone or abandoned: what the after links and the history's current step say. Not part of step_hash, since undo changes it.

step_hash.description: SHA-256 of this step's canonical JSON, without step_hash and state, followed by the previous step's step_hash (see the module description).

HistoryStep.title: HistoryStep

id.description: Unique within this file; stable when the store is renamed.

location.description: Absolute path to the folder holding catalog.json: a POSIX path, a Windows drive path or a UNC share.

read_only.description: When true, Debrief offers no action that would write to the store. A courtesy, not access control: filesystem permissions decide that (SEC-01).

LabelPositionEnum.description: Where an annotation's label is drawn, relative to it.
LabelPositionEnum.title: LabelPositionEnum

LengthUnitEnum.description: Units a length may be stored in (UCUM codes).
LengthUnitEnum.title: LengthUnitEnum

LineStyleEnum.description: How an annotation's line is drawn.
LineStyleEnum.title: LineStyleEnum

NonSpatialResult.description: A number, table or graph (TL-13), held column by column. A number is one column with one value; a graph plots its first column against the rest.
NonSpatialResult.title: NonSpatialResult

ObservationTypeEnum.description: Sensor observation types Debrief imports (CAP-22). Frequency is never imported.
ObservationTypeEnum.title: ObservationTypeEnum

explanation.description: Shown beside the field on the form (CAP-24).

minimum.description: Lower bound for number, integer and quantity kinds; for a quantity, in the default's unit.

ParameterKindEnum.description: Parameter kinds Debrief can build a form for (TL-07).
ParameterKindEnum.title: ParameterKindEnum

ParameterValue.description: A tool parameter value as supplied or recorded (TL-07, SUB-19). Scalars, or a quantity with its unit.
ParameterValue.title: ParameterValue

unit.description: UCUM unit code, required when quantity_kind is given.

PayloadRef.description: Envelope for data LinkML expresses badly (CON-02): the payload's format, a versioned reference to its inner schema, units, CRS and time reference.

crs.description: Coordinate reference system of any positions in the payload.

href.description: Path relative to the referencing file.

time_reference.description: Time scale of any times in the payload. Always UTC (SUB-01).

PayloadRef.title: PayloadRef

PlotFeature.description: The whole plot: its own details, and its view (the island). At most one per plot. Geometry is always null, so the plot file stays plain GeoJSON for other tools.
PlotFeature.title: PlotFeature

PlotHistory.description: A plot's whole history, kept in its plot file as the top-level member history (decision 13 Oct). Steps are numbered from 1 with no gaps, in the order they were made.

current.description: The step the plot's content reflects; 0 for none (an empty plot). Never an abandoned step.

head_hash.description: The last step's step_hash, or the starting value for a history with no steps, so a step removed from the end is noticed.

PlotHistory.title: PlotHistory

description.description: What the plot is for. Content.

title.description: The plot's title. Content, like everything outside view.

view.description: The island: how the plot is being viewed. Outside the plot's history (see the module description). Kept last, so it is easy to find and strip.

PlotView.description: View state saved in the plot file: not content, so not undoable and not recorded in provenance (SUB-22). Two people changing it at once are told, not silently overwritten (SUB-28). Later view state joins here.

context_tracks.description: How tracks outside the time window are drawn (CAP-29). Left out means visible.

time_window.description: The plot's time window: the period shown, one for the whole plot (CAP-28, CAP-29). Start shall not be after end.

PlotView.title: PlotView

PolygonGeometry.description: Linear rings; the first is the exterior. Each ring is closed (first position equals last).
PolygonGeometry.title: PolygonGeometry

notes.description: Free-text notes such as truncations or omitted content (EXT-14, EXT-15).

parameters.description: Parameter values the operation ran with, so replay can repeat it (SUB-19).

seed.description: Random seed, for operations that use randomness (SUB-20).

selected.description: Ids of the features the operation was applied to, in selection order, so replay can repeat it (SUB-19).

QuantityKindEnum.description: Physical quantity kinds that carry units (SUB-02).
QuantityKindEnum.title: QuantityKindEnum

ResultColumn.description: One column; exactly one of numbers or strings is given.

unit.description: UCUM unit code, required when quantity_kind is given.

ResultColumn.title: ResultColumn

plot.description: Href of the plot the selection belongs to.

SensorObservationsFeature.description: A set of sensor observations, such as weeks of bearings, held as an opaque payload (CON-02, NFR-06). Geometry is null; positions come from the host track at each observation time.
SensorObservationsFeature.title: SensorObservationsFeature

hidden.description: Not drawn on the map. Still listed, and still selectable, in the outline. Content: hiding is a recorded, undoable change (SUB-22).

SharedStateChange.description: A change to some or all of shared state, as set by a view or returned by a tool (TL-10, TL-11).

save_window.description: From a tool whose purpose is to set the time window: save time's range as the plot's window. Honoured only when the analyst ran the tool by hand on this plot; otherwise, and without it, a range beyond the saved window is shown, never saved (CAP-28). Needs time.

SharedStateChange.title: SharedStateChange

SourceRef.description: An immutable source file read by an operation (SUB-10, SUB-11).
SourceRef.title: SourceRef

SpeedUnitEnum.description: Units a speed may be stored in (UCUM codes).
SpeedUnitEnum.title: SpeedUnitEnum

key.description: The asset's key in the item's assets object; not written inside the asset.
The asset's key in the item's assets object; not written inside the asset.

StacCatalog.description: A static, file-based STAC catalogue (SUB-15). Holds one protection level (SEC-02).

debrief:schema_version.description: The newest data-file schema this catalogue holds (SUB-35).

StacCatalog.title: StacCatalog

StacItem.description: A STAC item. A plot is the item's "plot" asset (SUB-05, SUB-06).

items.description: [west, south, east, north] in WGS84 degrees.

StacItem.title: StacItem

datetime.description: Null when start_datetime and end_datetime are given.

StacLink.description: Parent links are authoritative; child links are a hint only and are never trusted (SUB-23).
StacLink.title: StacLink

StepStateEnum.description: Where a step stands, as the after links and the current step say.
StepStateEnum.title: StepStateEnum

StoreKindEnum.description: How a store is reached. Only static file catalogues so far (SUB-15).
StoreKindEnum.title: StoreKindEnum

TimeRange.description: A closed interval of time. Start shall not be after end.
TimeRange.title: TimeRange

ToolDeclaration.description: How a tool describes itself to Debrief, agents and hooks (TL-04, TL-06).

applies_to.description: Feature kinds from the taxonomy, or "*" for any (TL-06). Debrief offers a tool only if every selected item matches (TL-08).

explanation.description: Short user-facing explanation of what the tool does (CAP-24).

judgement.description: Any judgement the tool involves, shown on its form (CAP-24).

name.description: Dotted, unique across loaded libraries, for example core.smooth_track.

uses_randomness.description: When true, Debrief records the seed (SUB-20).

ToolDeclaration.title: ToolDeclaration

ToolRef.description: The tool and version that performed an operation (SUB-24).
ToolRef.title: ToolRef

ToolResult.description: What a tool run returns (TL-11). Any combination of parts may be present.
ToolResult.title: ToolResult

TrackEdit.description: A track moved, rotated, sheared or stretched by hand, as the map, a form or an agent describes it (CAP-01, CAP-02, CAP-21): one recorded, undoable step in the plot's history (SUB-19). Geodesic: a move takes every fix in the period the same range along the same bearing, each along its own geodesic; a rotation keeps each fix's range from the pivot and turns its bearing from the pivot by the angle. A shear and a stretch hold one end of the period (the anchor) and work in the azimuthal equidistant frame about it, where a geodesic through the anchor is a straight line: a shear adds to each fix the dragged end's displacement times the fix's fraction of the time from the anchor to the dragged end; a stretch scales each fix's range from the anchor, keeping its bearing from it. Either way a straight, steady leg stays a straight, steady leg. Fixes outside the period stay where they are, so the joins jump. A single fix moved (move_fix) goes where it is told, alone: its neighbours, its time and its recorded course and speed stay. Dead reckoning (dead_reckon) places each fix of the period from the one before by that fix's recorded course and speed, from the period's first fix.

anchor.description: The end of the period a shear or a stretch holds fixed.

angle.description: How far a rotation turns the fixes about the pivot; positive is clockwise.

bearing.description: Which way a move takes each fix, a shear drags the end that is not held, or a single fix is moved, true, clockwise from north.

course.description: The course made good a shear gives the period: the true bearing, at its first fix, of the geodesic from its first fix to its last. With speed, instead of a distance and a bearing for the dragged end.

distance.description: How far a move takes each fix, a shear drags the end that is not held, or a single fix is moved.

fix_time.description: The time of the one fix a move_fix moves: the fix is found by its time, as a mark is (where two fixes share a time, the first).

period.description: The fixes to change: those whose times fall in it, ends included. Left out, the whole track.

pivot.description: [longitude, latitude] of the position a rotation turns about. Left out, the fix nearest current time in the period, or the period's first fix.

position.description: [longitude, latitude] a move_fix puts the fix at, instead of a distance and a bearing from where it is.

speed.description: The speed made good a shear or a stretch gives the period: the geodesic range from its first fix to its last over the time between.

TrackEdit.title: TrackEdit

TrackEditAnchorEnum.description: Which end of the period a shear or a stretch holds fixed; the other end is the one dragged.
TrackEditAnchorEnum.title: TrackEditAnchorEnum

TrackFeature.description: A platform track. Per-position values are parallel arrays matching the geometry.
TrackFeature.title: TrackFeature

courses.description: Course over ground at each position, true north, clockwise.

depths.description: Depth below the sea surface at each position, positive down. Absent where depth is not known.

fix_marks.description: Fixes with a colour, a label or a comment of their own, in time order, each found by its time (CAP-01, EXT-14). Most fixes have none, so only marked fixes are listed. Content: each change is a recorded, undoable step (SUB-22).

hidden.description: Not drawn on the map. Still listed, and still selectable, in the outline. Content: hiding is a recorded, undoable change (SUB-22).

speeds.description: Speed over ground at each position.

TrackStyle.description: How a track is drawn. Data colours do not change with the theme (DEV-07). Colour is content: the analyst changing it (blue friendly to red enemy, say) is a recorded, undoable change (SUB-22).

legacy_symbology.description: The REP symbology code the colour came from, such as "@C", kept for export.

TrackStyle.title: TrackStyle

config_version.description: Version of this file's layout. Currently 1.

stores.description: Known stores, in the order the analyst sees them (SUB-17).

items.description: [west, south, east, north] in WGS84 degrees, independent of display projection.

annotation.description: An annotation as the form describes it (show_annotation_form, save_annotation), as drawn on the map (annotation_drawn), or as changed on the map (edit_annotation).

context_tracks.description: How tracks outside the time window are drawn (CAP-29).

current_time.description: Current time from shared state, which a tool form offers for its time fields.

feature_id.description: The annotation a form changes or deletes, the annotation or track the map asks to change, or the track whose fixes it rings or the analyst chose.

fix_time.description: The time of the fix the analyst chose on the map (fix_chosen).

fix_times.description: The times of the fixes the map rings (show_fixes).

hidden_count.description: How many of the plot's features are hidden on the map (SUB-22), so the map can say so.

minimum_context_contrast.description: The analyst's setting that shows faint context tracks as visible, so the time controller can say so.

preview.description: A track as a change would leave it, one position per fix, drawn beside it until the analyst applies or cancels the change (show_fixes).

saved_window.description: The time window as saved in the plot, so the time controller can say when the window shown differs from it (CAP-28).

time_range.description: The plot's period, so times can be entered as the analyst reads them (show_form) and the time window set within it (show_time); or the time window to save (window_changed).

track_edit.description: How the analyst moved, rotated, sheared or stretched a track, or moved one of its fixes, on the map (edit_track).

description: The unit of analysis (SUB-05), stored as an asset of a STAC item.

history.description: The plot's whole history: every step, with its provenance and whether it is applied, undone or abandoned, and the current step (SUB-19, SUB-21, decision 13 Oct). A GeoJSON foreign member, so other tools still read the file as GeoJSON. Not content: left out of every content hash. Last in the file. A plot sent to a view or a tool never carries it.
